description: This file defines the JsonApiErrorObject class within the SuiteCRM namespace, representing error objects conforming to the JSON API specification. It includes properties, validation, and serialization methods for error details, as well as mechanisms to populate error information from exceptions and HTTP requests.

classes.name: JsonApiErrorObject
classes.description: Represents an error object with properties such as id, links, status, code, title, detail, source, and meta, conforming to JSON API error format. Provides methods to set, validate, export, and populate error details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the error object with optional properties such as title, detail, id, code, status, links, source, and meta, with default fallbacks.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title property if valid.

methods.name: setDetail
methods.description: Sets the detail property if valid.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id property if valid.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code property if valid.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status property if valid.

methods.name: setLinks
methods.description: Sets the links property if valid.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source property if valid.

methods.name: setMeta
methods.description: Sets the meta property if valid.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Exports the error object properties as an associative array.

methods.name: exportJson
methods.description: Returns the JSON-encoded string of the error object.

methods.name: retrieveMetaFromException
methods.description: Builds meta information from a given exception for debugging and error reporting.

methods.name: retrieveFromException
methods.description: Populates the error object from an exception instance.

methods.name: retrieveFromRequest
methods.description: Populates the source property from an HTTP request object.
